definitions.explanation: Describes a slow, steady progression or change over time.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{徐々|じょじょ}に{暗|くら}くなってきた。
{病気|びょうき}は{徐々|じょじょ}に{回復|かいふく}している。
{彼|かれ}の{日本語|にほんご}は{徐々|じょじょ}に{上達|じょうたつ}している。

notes:
{徐々|じょじょ}に emphasizes a slow, steady pace of change without abrupt shifts. The kanji {徐|じょ} means "slowly" and is repeated for emphasis.

POSITION:
Typically placed directly before the verb it modifies: {徐々|じょじょ}に{変|か}わる, {徐々|じょじょ}に{増|ふ}える.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{回復|かいふく}する: to gradually recover
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{慣|な}れる: to gradually get used to
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{増|ふ}える: to gradually increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: slowly, steadily (slightly formal)
- だんだん: gradually (casual, everyday)
- {次第|しだい}に: increasingly, progressively (literary/formal)
- ゆっくり: slowly (focuses on speed, not progression)
